messages:
laura-support: Hi team — BrightCo says their Apr AWS Marketplace invoice is $15,420 but our usage dashboard shows $11,980. They want clarification and possible credit.

 tom-billing: please attach the invoice pdf and the marketplace order id + our account id.

 laura-support: uploaded invoice: https://files.redwood.example/brightco/apr-invoice.pdf
 Marketplace order id: 1122334455
 Redwood account id: brightco-987

 anita-aws: quick checklist: (1) commit/reserved SKU on invoice? (2) multiple listings aggregated under same order? (3) promos or reseller fees. Pull the detailed line items export.

 kyle-platform: I can run our mapping job to match AWS SKUs -> internal product ids. Will run now and paste a diff.

 rachel-finance: flagging that if there's an unexplained delta > $2k we should consider a provisional credit while we investigate.

 kyle-platform: pasted CSV join snippet:
```
redwood_account,aws_sku,aws_qty,redwood_mapped_qty,delta_usd
brightco-987,redwood.tokens,10400000,10400000,0.00
brightco-987,redwood.dedicated.commit,1,0,8000.00
brightco-987,redwood.support.addon,1,0,300.00
brightco-987,unknown.sku.536,2500000,0,1220.00
```
 Invoice sum from these lines = 9520 but PDF total = 15420. Missing ~5900.

 anita-aws: run `aws marketplace commerce` export to include sellerId/billingEntity. Sometimes AWS invoices include third-party reseller margins that don't map to our usage.

 laura-support: requested full AWS usages csv from buyer's console and asked BrightCo to confirm if multiple AWS accounts were consolidated under the same marketplace buyer.

 brightco-j.singh: Confirmed they have two AWS buyer accounts consolidated under MasterAccount ID 999000111. They thought all charges would be visible in our dashboard.

 kyle-platform: that explains part. Our ingestion only pulls usage for the linked buyer account we were given (999000111:acct-a). If master account aggregated charges from acct-b, those SKUs won't be in our dataset. Need to request acct-b's metering export or ask AWS to show which buyer account contributed.

 tom-billing: opening AWS case. Attach invoice, our diff report, and ask for `meteringRecordId` attribution and buyerAccountId breakdown.

 laura-support: AWS case opened: 3456789012. They requested samples of meteringRecordId to trace. We have no meteringRecordId in our logs; only order_id and request ids.

 kyle-platform: tweak: add logging to capture `awsMeteringRecordId` from the Marketplace Metering API responses. For now, we can ask BrightCo to run a small repro with trace ids so AWS can map them.

 laura-support: sent repro script to customer. Script:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <TEMP_KEY>" -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":5}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -D - | grep x-request-id
```
 They returned three x-request-id values and timestamps; uploaded to AWS case.

 anita-aws: AWS replied preliminarily: two extra line items are from a reseller partner 'CloudResellInc' and billed under a different sellerId. They suggest reseller added a managed services fee. Asking CloudResellInc for breakdown.

 rachel-finance: finance approved provisional credit of up to $5,800 pending confirmation of reseller fee duplication. Put invoice on hold.

 tom-billing: if AWS confirms reseller fee is not ours, we will credit the customer and then file for reimbursement from CloudResellInc or adjust revenue recognition.

 kyle-platform: long-term action: change our onboarding to capture all buyer accounts under a customer's master account and ingest all marketplace buyerAccountId usages. Filing product ticket.

 laura-support: updating BrightCo: \"We're investigating with AWS and a provisional credit has been placed. Will update once AWS confirms which seller billed the extra line items.\" :wave:

 aws-billing-bot: AWS case 3456789012 status -> Awaiting partner response (2026-04-07)

 laura-support: leaving this open until partner confirmation. tagging @tom-billing @rachel-finance @kyle-platform
